scene nightsky
The stars are shining, the air is cool, and I’m on my way to a distant convenience store to bother a girl who is more than likely thinking about having sex with me right now.
scene kirinwalkhome1
There must be some sort of special tonight, though, as I get two for the price of one the moment I arrive.
: Just out of curiosity, are you two ever not together?
: Not really. Kirin follows me around a lot.
: She’s kind of like a horny puppy who keeps trying to hump my leg.
: I have no other options when she won’t let me hump her face.
: Keep at it, Kirin. You’ll get your wish one day.
: He says, not realizing it is he who prevents my wishes from coming true in the first place.
: Are you here to see me, Sensei? Or are you just passing by on your way to hang out with Tsuneyo again? Answer honestly. I promise I won’t get jealous when you tell me it's the latter.
: I’m actually here for Kirin. I installed a GPS tracking device on her phone when she wasn’t looking and I can now pinpoint where she is at all times.
: I know that’s supposed to creep me out, but I kind of like it.
: You’d have to figure out the passcode to her phone before you could do that, wouldn’t you?
: Is it 6969?
scene kirinwalkhome2
: Aww. It’s always so cute when you unintentionally remind me of how close we are.
: Hey! We have the same passcode! Now we can spy on one another and go through each other’s camera rolls!
scene kirinwalkhome3
: Wow, good idea! I definitely haven’t already gone into your phone and sent myself copies of the nudes you sent Sensei!
if kirinlust20 == True:
: I saw one of yours too, but I don’t know if it was for him or your sister. You have really nice nipples.
: Thank you, Noriko! It was for Sensei.
: Can you please not throw me under the bus every chance you get? It’s starting to wear me down.
else:
: I didn’t find any in your phone. I was actually really surprised. Tons of porn, though. I didn’t realize you had such a thing for twins.
: It’s kind of sad how I can pinpoint exactly when you must have looked at my phone by the porn you found.
: A little, yeah.
scene kirinwalkhome4
: Anyway, assuming the GPS tracker thing is true, which I kind of hope it is...are you actually here to see me?
: No. I’m here for Noriko. How would I have even known you were here?
scene kirinwalkhome5
: Ugh, that was such an easy opportunity for you to earn points with me and you completely squandered it.
: It earned plenty of points with me!
: Cool, but what the fuck is he going to do with them when you’d already do literally anything he asks?
: Would you not? Because I’m pretty sure you were in that same boat before I even met Noriko.
: Re-met Noriko. Don’t forget the years and years I spent secretly being in love with you.
: There’s a clear difference there, Sensei. I would do anything you ask me to do because I am a horrible, deviant person. Noriko would do anything you ask because she is your pet.
: That’s what the collar’s for, you know. There’s a slot on the back you can attach a leash to. I keep the one that came with it in my underwear drawer.
scene kirinwalkhome6
: Oh, is that what that was? I thought it was a belt.
: Stop taking my panties, Kirin.
: Why? I always put them back.
: Ignoring the fact that Noriko might actually be a dog and the equally unsurprising fact that Kirin will do anything to get herself off, it’s nice seeing you two so together all the time.
: Most people would think that two roommates would struggle balancing a shared sexual connection with one guy without their feelings starting to get in the way.
scene kirinwalkhome7
: Maybe. But I don’t have feelings for you. That’s Noriko’s thing. I’m the cool sex friend you secretly invite on business trips and bone on the side.
: Also, even with you and me teetering off the precipice of finally making our genitals touch, as well as my infallible desire to have my first time with you be private-
: With a special exception made for her best friend.
: No. But, as I was saying, even with that we’re probably, like...the second or third dorm room closest to having casual threesomes with you!
: Is this like Uta’s “Sensei love journal” thing? Are you two ranking the sexual stuff while Uta ranks how much I care about everyone?
: What else are we supposed to do in class? You don’t make us work.
: There’s some disagreement on who we have for first place, though. My money’s on Dorm 7. In fact, I’d be really surprised if Uta & Io aren’t already screwing around together.
: And what-
: Makoto and Miku and it’s not even close.
scene kirinwalkhome8
: But they’re the only dorm room that’s completely straight. I’ve confirmed at least one bisexual member of every other room.
: What? How?
scene kirinwalkhome9
: I asked.
: Damn. If only Rin had that idea.
: Dorm 2 and Dorm 9 have both technically not admitted to anything indicating a break in pure heterosexuality thus far, but that is subject to change based on progression throughout the year.
: I remain steadfast in my predictions of both Sana’s lesbian awakening as well as Yasu’s pansexual one.
: It’s really surprising just how much a room can accomplish when both of the girls in it were born without filters.
scene kirinwalkhome10
: It also helps that pretty much everyone likes me and doesn’t mind telling me stuff.
: I don’t have any exceptional social abilities like Noriko does, but I’m pretty sure my drive and thirst for sexual knowledge help in some way too.
: Not like I’m complaining, but do you two ever talk about anything that isn’t sexual?
: We go to the movies sometimes?
scene kirinwalkhome11
: Oh, speaking of which, I should probably start heading back. I have to stop at home to watch some stupid fucking video with my parents.
: It’s not one of those “Pray the gay away” things, is it? Because I watched some documentary last night about homosexuality in Japan and what some of those parents do is fucking wild.
scene kirinwalkhome12
: God, I wish. At least that sounds entertaining. We’re watching their stupid fucking wedding video. They make a whole thing out of it every year and we all have to watch it together.
: Everybody always fucking cries and talks about how cute it is and blah, blah, blah. Weddings are stupid. I’m never getting married. It looks exhausting.
if kirinmarry == True:
: Really? Even after I chose you in that fuck, marry, kill game?
scene kirinwalkhome13
: Wh...Why do you even remember that?! That was so long ago! And was literally just a game! There’s no way we’re ever actually getting married!
: Can you seriously picture me gathering kids up and making hot chocolate while we all sit around and pull from the same box of tissues?!
: I imagine that same scene every night...It’s the last thing I think of before going to sleep.
scene kirinwalkhome14
: S...Shut up! No it’s not!
: Uhh...well ignoring Kirin’s thoughts on marriage, why don’t you take this chance to walk her home?
else:
: Never?
scene kirinwalkhome15
: Do you want to get married?
: No...but you’re not me. You’re in high school.
: For all we know, this whole rebellious thing of yours could end any day now and you could turn into another Karin but...with smaller boobs and more sexual experience.
: That’s the single dumbest thing you’ve ever said.
: Ignoring Kirin’s thoughts on marriage, why don’t you take this chance to walk her home?
scene kirinwalkhome16
: Hm? Why? I can walk myself home. I do it all the time.
: Are you sure? You don’t want to, you know, use this time to be alone?
: I’ve gotta do inventory tonight. I’ve been slacking off way too much lately and having you around will just make me slack off even more.
: I mean...okay. If it’s fine with Kirin, I can walk her home.
scene kirinwalkhome17
: It’s fine with me. All the homeless people around here creep the fuck out of me anyway. But if you try to hold my hand, I’m going to make you walk five steps behind me.
: When have I literally ever tried to do that before?
: When have you ever been nice enough to walk me home before? I normally just blow you and leave.
: In my defense, this was Noriko’s idea.
: Yeah. Sorry for forcing you two who definitely don’t like one another together. I’ll think harder about my choices next time.
scene kirinwalkhome18
: What are you talking about? Of course I like Sensei.
: I just happen to like his penis more.
: Which is fair. That is my greatest feature, after all.
: Call me when you get home? I can put you on speaker while I count boxes of Twinkies.
: It’s a date.
: And this is exactly why I don’t date. You two are gross.
scene black
Kirin and I exit the convenience store together and take off in the direction of her parents’ house.
The homeless are out in full force tonight.
Thankfully, “full force” for them just means leaning up against chain-link fences and staring at us as we move through the streets.
There’s one person in particular, an old woman with grayed-out hair and several missing teeth, who opens her mouth and shouts something incoherent at us.
Kirin jumps.
It’s the first time I’ve ever heard any of them speak, if you could even call that indiscernible cry “speaking.”
And so I misinterpret it as a desperate plea for help and lose myself for a moment, turning back toward her to stare once more.
She yanks out one of her few remaining teeth and throws it at me.
It lands at my feet, covered in blood and what I assume is gum-residue.
Kirin never notices.
scene kirinwalkhome19
But then we make it to a riverbank and things begin again.

The silence and unease disintegrates, leaving nothing but the two of us and a fading crooked skyline comprised of abandoned apartment buildings, decorating the murky water with reflections of the past.
Within them, if I focus hard enough, I can see into the windows.
And in those rooms, now devoid of everything, were people.
Some were eating, some were dancing-
But all of them were blind.
I could tell by the lack of irises.
: So, was I right?
: Right about what?
: Makoto & Miku, obviously. Have you three taken the plunge yet? What’s Makoto like in bed?
: Is this really what we’re going to talk about?
: If we talk about anything else, we might accidentally enjoy ourselves.
: And that would be bad...why?
scene kirinwalkhome20
: Well, it wouldn’t be right to steal Noriko’s thunder right when you two are...how did she word it again? “On the precipice of making your genitals touch?”
: Yeah, I have no idea why she put it that way.
scene kirinwalkhome21
: Because she’s nervous. I’m pretty sure her heart hasn’t stopped palpitating ever since she dry-humped you on the beach.
: Which reminds me, I’m mad at you.
: What? Why?
: A few reasons.
: Not only did you totally butcher Noriko’s big moment by bailing on her to go see someone else, but you neglected to tell me that you made it to third base with Miku.
: Oh yeah. Surprise.
: Yeah. Surprise.
if kirinlust30 == True:
: You toyed with me on purpose when I brought her to your hotel room.
: You knew that I wouldn’t feel bad if I’d known you two had already started messing around.
: So you took advantage of me and made me feel like shit. I won’t forget that.
: Well, excuse me for exposing your humanity. I didn’t realize you were so opposed to it.
: No, I think you’re misunderstanding something. Yes, I’m mad. And yes, that is in large part to you taking advantage of me, but it’s not like there was no...unexpected benefit that came from it.
: Like?
scene kirinwalkhome22
: Well, for one, I think I might have a humiliation kink now.
: But the more impactful part is that all of those things you said made me feel...different.
: It’s not often I feel genuinely bad about the things that I do. But Miku has always been a thing in my life that I’ve truly wanted to protect.
: You mean when you're not taking advantage of her for being high, right?
: Yeah, exactly.
: There’s a lot of stuff I “almost” go through with. And that night, I was probably hoping she would have talked me out of it.
: You see, when things become too real, I normally still have an out. And once she agreed, my choices were to either admit that I’m weak or just go along with it.
: As you saw, I went along with it.
scene kirinwalkhome21
: You made me pay for that. And, while I’m mad, I appreciate it.
: I didn’t think you had it in you.
scene kirinwalkhome23
: But, then again, I didn’t think Miku had it in her to let a grown man finger her and here we are.
: Maybe I’m less special than I thought?
: Well, the Noriko thing I can understand. I feel bad about that as well. But I fully intend to make up for it soon.
scene kirinwalkhome24
: Don’t fuck her just to “make up for it.” She’s not me. She won’t be able to separate sex from the more mushy, emotional parts of it.
: That’s not-
: Just say “okay.” I don’t want to get any more involved in your Romeo & Juliet bullshit than I already am.
: Can I comment on the Miku thing, at least?
: Yes, because that I do want to get more involved in.
: Were you keeping it a secret on purpose? Or did you just not think it was important enough to tell me about it?
: Honestly? I didn’t think about it at all.
scene kirinwalkhome25
: I appreciate your “drive and thirst for sexual knowledge” or whatever, but that doesn’t mean I’m going to hand-deliver all of my new sexual encounters to you so you can rate and review them.
: Not even the ones with people who are important to me?
: You’ve proven there’s no issue getting that information from those people directly, so I don’t really see what me being the one to tell you instead of them accomplishes.
: You don’t?
: No, I really don’t.
: You really don’t understand why I’m mad about you keeping the Miku thing a secret from me?
: It’s not because you still like her, is it? I thought you got over that a while ago?
: I love Miku, but I don’t like her. Like, don’t get me wrong, I would do heinous things to that little tomboy if given the opportunity, but that’s not why I’m upset.
: Then why-
: Because it’s both of you.
: What?
scene kirinwalkhome26
: Listen, I am not the kind of girl who’s going to go on some long-winded rant about what you mean to me or my feelings or any of that stuff because-
: Well, frankly, all of that makes me way more uncomfortable than anything involving sex ever will.
: But when two people that I’m close to hook up in a way I can understand and relate to and feel good about...not telling me is like, robbing me of that happiness or whatever.
scene kirinwalkhome27
: Like I said, I suck when it comes to explaining things like this. It would have been way easier if I could’ve just blackmailed you about it instead or something.
: When it comes down to it, I’m happy for you two. What I’m upset about is not being included in something I thought I would be included in.
: Like, I feel like I’m making a bigger deal out of this development than either of you are and that’s like, totally weird for me.
: I think the weirdest part of all is how you’re able to root for both Miku and Noriko without feeling like you have to choose sides.
scene kirinwalkhome28

: Yeah...but as long as you’re able to keep things under wraps, which you’ve been pretty good at so far, I think everyone might be able to walk away when this is all said and done without getting hurt.
: Fortunately, I don’t think that’s much of an issue with Miku as she seems to be entirely open to me being with...literally everyone that I want to be with.
scene kirinwalkhome29
: Yeah, what’s up with that? I got that same vibe on the beach and it, like...totally threw me for a loop.

scene kirinwalkhome30
: Hey, how can you be so sure? For all we know, I might be a major role model for her on her way to sexual addiction.
: Probably because Miku is actually okay with me seeing other people and you’re just pretending to be.
scene kirinwalkhome31
: I’m...what?
: Why would you say that? That’s not true. That’s definitely not true. Where did you get that idea?
: Well, let me ask you this-
: If I asked you to abandon everyone and everything else to run away with me right now, would you?
: We could fuck a million times a day...and “watch the world burn” or whatever it was you said when we first started hanging out.
: If I gave you the chance to have me all to yourself, would you take it?
scene nightsky
: Yeah.
: We should do it.
: We should leave everyone...and everything else behind.
: It was a hypothetical question, Kirin. I’m not actually asking you to do this with me. I just wanted to prove a point.
scene kirinwalkhome32
: Why does it have to be hypothetical?
: If we can make a world for ourselves amidst all of this shit...why don’t we just do it?
: What’s stopping us?
: We probably care more about other people than we let ourselves believe.
: You and I are similar in that way. We don’t like admitting to things we think are weaknesses, but the fact we think of them as weaknesses at all is confusing.
: Am I not enough for you?
: I don’t think you are.
: Am I enough for you?
: Do you...
: Maybe want to hold hands on the way home?
: Just because it would be, like...ironic. For us to do that, I mean. Since we’re just not the type and whatnot.
: Not really.
: Y...Yeah! Me neither, obviously. That was just a joke anyway. As if we would...
: Ever do...
scene black
: Are you sure?...
I’ve always been weak, so I let her get the better of me three times before the night comes to an end.
The first is when I take her hand at the edge of the riverbank.
The second is when she takes my arm beneath a crumbling overpass.
The third is when I take her lips just outside her parents’ home.
As I walk away, I recall a recent reflection.
I recall bodies in windows and eyes without irises.
And I tell myself it matters not if those who peer through glass are blind at all.
What matters is what they think about the things they see.
And what those thoughts could do to me.
